title: Improving model.go Organization
description: A walkthrough of the current model.go structure and recommendations for better code organization and maintainability

steps.title: Model Struct Definition
steps.description: The Model struct holds all TUI state. Notice how it contains both UI state (width, height, list) and business logic (navigator, walker). Only the struct definition (line 6) is highlighted here.

steps.title: Update Method Entry
steps.description: The Update() method is the heart of the TUI. It uses a tea.Msg switch to handle different events. This single line (line 10) is the entry point.

steps.title: Key Handling
steps.description: Keyboard events are handled in a nested switch. Here we handle 'ctrl+c' to quit. Only this single case is highlighted.

steps.title: AppState Enum
steps.description: The AppState enum defines the different modes the TUI can be in. Each state represents a different screen or mode of operation.

steps.title: Message Types
steps.description: These message types define the communication protocol between the TUI components. They represent async events like file loading.

steps.title: displayWidth Function
steps.description: This utility function calculates visual width, handling tabs as 4 spaces and ignoring control characters. Only the function signature is highlighted.

steps.title: NewModel Function
steps.description: NewModel() creates the initial TUI state. It initializes the list, text input, walker, styles, and highlighter components.

steps.title: loadCurrentStepFile
steps.description: This async command loads the file content for the current step. It reads lines from the file based on the step's line range.

steps.title: View - StateViewing
steps.description: The StateViewing case renders the main split-pane view with code on the left and sidebar on the right. Only the case entry is highlighted.

steps.title: HighlightLineStyle
steps.description: This style provides a light background to highlight the relevant lines from the step. The remaining lines show as plain text for context.
